dedupe_keys.name: addis ababa city road traffic accident severity dataset

description: Addis Ababa City Road Traffic Accident Severity Dataset is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by figshare. This dataset contains traffic accident records from Addis Ababa City, Ethiopia, spanning the years 2016 to 2022. The dataset includes 13,064 rows and 31 features related to various factors influencing road traffic accident severity. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher figshare. Its tags are Public transport, Road transportation and freight services, Adversarial machine learning, Data engineering and data science. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
